concerns.text: Task T015 description permits automatic off‑load of the quantized inference step to a free Kaggle GPU when the CPU run exceeds 5 h or OOM, which directly violates Constitution Principle VI that mandates all KL‑divergence measurements be performed on a CPU‑only quantized engine.

The plan cites `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-2-3B-4bit-gguf` as the "full‑precision FP16" model used for gradient‑norm and curvature extraction. This checkpoint is a 4‑bit quantized GGUF file, not a true full‑precision FP16 model, making it inappropriate for obtaining accurate training‑side signals required by FR‑001 and FR‑004.
